map.频率转音名：MIDI 音号 n = 69 + 12·log₂(f ÷ 440)；: Frequency to note name: MIDI note number n = 69 + 12·log₂(f ÷ 440); the nearest note maps round(n) onto the twelve-tone equal temperament (C, C#, D, D#, E, F, F#, G, G#, A, A#, B), octave number = ⌊round(n) ÷ 12⌋ − 1; cent deviation = round((n − round(n)) × 100). Validation: non-empty guard for f. Criteria: no fixed grading; a deviation ≥ 0 is shown with “+”, and 440 Hz corresponds to A4 (n = 69).
